name: Kingy AI Price Index
citation: Kingy AI Price Index, October 2026 edition. Kingy AI. https://kingy.ai/ai-price-index/2026-10/

edition.label: October 2026
edition.headline: In October 2026, a million AI tokens cost a median $4.00 from frontier models (down 11.1%), $4.00 from mid-range models (no change) and $0.26 from small models (down 50.0%). A typical AI subscription cost $20.00 a month (no change), and top plans cost $200.00 (no change). Changes compare with September.

story.title: Small-model prices fell 50% in October
story.text: The median small model cost $0.26 per million tokens, down from $0.53 in September, as Anthropic and OpenAI replaced their small models with cheaper successors.
